tools.name: firenook_status
tools.description: The running Firenook suite: how the project was found, hub locator, hub status, the emulators listing (host and port per service) and the CLI version; with no project, the suites whose locators answer.

tools.name: emulators_export
tools.description: Export the running Firestore, Auth and Storage data to a directory outside the project (firenook emulators:export).

tools.name: firestore_get
tools.description: Read one Firestore document by path (collection/document[/subcollection/document]); returns its fields as plain JSON or exists:false.

tools.name: firestore_query
tools.description: Run a structured query over one collection, or with collectionGroup over every collection with that id (Firestore runQuery): optional where filters, ordering and limit; returns matching documents as plain JSON.

collection.description: Collection path, e.g. users or users/alice/posts; with collectionGroup a collection id (posts) or a path whose parent bounds it

collectionGroup.description: Collection-group query: every collection with the last segment's id at any depth under the parent (the database root for a bare id, e.g. posts; users/alice/posts for one document's descendants)

tools.name: firestore_count
tools.description: Count the documents of a collection, or with collectionGroup of every collection with that id, that match optional where filters (a COUNT aggregation; no documents are read back).

collection.description: Collection path, or a collection id with collectionGroup

collectionGroup.description: Collection-group query: every collection with the last segment's id at any depth under the parent (the database root for a bare id, e.g. posts; users/alice/posts for one document's descendants)

tools.name: firestore_set
tools.description: Write a Firestore document from plain JSON: replaces it, or with merge:true updates only the given top-level fields.

tools.name: firestore_delete
tools.description: Delete a document (recursive:true also its subcollections) or a collection (its documents; recursive:true everything beneath) through the emulator delete route.

tools.name: firestore_list_collections
tools.description: List collection ids at the database root or under a document (listCollectionIds).

path.description: Document path; omit for the root collections

tools.name: auth_list_users
tools.description: List Auth emulator accounts (accounts:batchGet) with uid, email, phone, display name, claims and provider data.

tools.name: auth_get_user
tools.description: Look up one Auth account by uid, email or phone number (accounts:lookup).

tools.name: auth_create_user
tools.description: Create an Auth emulator account with a synthetic email/password, phone number or display name (never real credentials).

tools.name: auth_delete_user
tools.description: Delete one Auth emulator account by uid (accounts:delete).

tools.name: auth_oob_codes
tools.description: The pending out-of-band codes (email verification, password reset, sign-in links) the Auth emulator holds instead of sending email.

tools.name: auth_verification_codes
tools.description: The pending phone verification codes the Auth emulator holds instead of sending SMS.

tools.name: auth_mint_token
tools.description: Mint a Firebase ID token (valid one hour) and refresh token for an existing Auth emulator user, so an agent can call a function or the REST API as that user; claims replace the custom claims for this token only.

tenant.description: Tenant id; omit for a project-level user

claims.description: Custom claims for this token only (nothing is stored); omit for the user's own

provider.description: Sign-in provider the token names, e.g. password or phone; default the user's first

tools.name: auth_set_claims
tools.description: Set an Auth emulator user's custom claims: replace them (as the Admin SDK's setCustomUserClaims does) or with mode merge change only the given keys (a null value removes that key).

tenant.description: Tenant id; omit for a project-level user

tools.name: auth_remove_claims
tools.description: Remove the named custom claim keys from an Auth emulator user, keeping its other claims.

tenant.description: Tenant id; omit for a project-level user

tools.name: auth_disable_user
tools.description: Disable an Auth emulator account: its sign-ins and token refreshes fail until it is enabled again.

tenant.description: Tenant id; omit for a project-level user

tools.name: auth_enable_user
tools.description: Enable a disabled Auth emulator account again.

tenant.description: Tenant id; omit for a project-level user

tools.name: auth_revoke_tokens
tools.description: Revoke an Auth emulator user's refresh tokens (validSince moves to now), so its existing sessions must sign in again.

tenant.description: Tenant id; omit for a project-level user

tools.name: auth_list_tenants
tools.description: List the Auth emulator's tenants (multi-tenancy) with their user counts and sign-in settings.

q.description: Match tenant id or display name (substring)

tools.name: storage_list
tools.description: List Storage objects and folder prefixes under a prefix (one level, like listAll).

prefix.description: Folder prefix, e.g. uploads/ (a trailing slash is added)

tools.name: storage_get_metadata
tools.description: The metadata of one Storage object (content type, size, timestamps, custom metadata, download tokens) or exists:false.

tools.name: storage_read
tools.description: Read a Storage object's content: text inline (text, JSON, XML, SVG...), anything else as base64; at most maxBytes are returned and truncated says whether there is more.

bucket.description: Storage bucket; default the suite's default bucket

maxBytes.description: Most bytes to return; default 65536, at most 1048576

encoding.description: auto (default) picks text for textual content types

tools.name: storage_upload
tools.description: Upload (create or replace) a Storage object from text or base64 bytes with a content type and custom metadata, as the Admin SDK would (rules skipped; finalize triggers run).

bucket.description: Storage bucket; default the suite's default bucket

base64.description: Content as base64 bytes (instead of text)

contentType.description: Content type; default text/plain for text, application/octet-stream for base64

ifNotExists.description: Refuse to replace an existing object

tools.name: storage_delete
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: delete one Storage object, or with a path ending in / every object under that folder.

bucket.description: Storage bucket; default the suite's default bucket

path.description: Object path, or a folder ending in /

tools.name: storage_copy
tools.description: Copy a Storage object (or a folder, a path ending in /) to a new path, in the same or another bucket; refuses to overwrite unless overwrite is true.

bucket.description: Storage bucket; default the suite's default bucket

path.description: Source object path, or a folder ending in /

toBucket.description: Destination bucket; default the source bucket

tools.name: storage_move
tools.description: Move (rename) a Storage object or a folder (a path ending in /), in the same or another bucket; refuses to overwrite unless overwrite is true.

bucket.description: Storage bucket; default the suite's default bucket

path.description: Source object path, or a folder ending in /

toBucket.description: Destination bucket; default the source bucket

tools.name: functions_list
tools.description: The functions loaded by the running suite: name, region, generation, trigger kind, event type or schedule, and the HTTPS URL of request/callable functions.

tools.name: functions_invoke
tools.description: Invoke a loaded function: an HTTPS/callable request with data, or with eventData a background event (Firestore before/after, Storage object, Pub/Sub message, Auth user, schedule, Eventarc custom event, task queue payload) shaped as the official functions shell sends it.

region.description: Region when the name is deployed in several

eventData.description: Background event payload; its shape depends on the trigger

resource.description: Firestore document path or the legacy resource name

params.description: Wildcard values for the trigger pattern

eventType.description: Override the CloudEvent type for Eventarc custom events

method.description: HTTP method for plain HTTPS functions; default POST

tools.name: functions_list_calls
tools.description: Recent function calls, newest first: trigger kind and cause, outcome (succeeded, failed, timedOut, crashed...), HTTP status, duration and the first line of the error.

function.description: Only this function: its name or <region>-<name> id

outcome.description: Only calls that ended this way

q.description: Extra filter terms, e.g. took:>200ms status:>=500 is:cold

tools.name: functions_get_call
tools.description: One function call in full: its cause, request (method, path, headers, body), response (status, body), event payload, the error with its stack trace, the call's console output and timings.

maxBodyChars.description: Cut each body at this many characters; default 16384

tools.name: functions_replay_call
tools.description: Run a recorded function call again with the same request or event (after a fix, say) and report the new call: outcome, status, response body and its id for functions_get_call.

maxBodyChars.description: Cut the response body at this many characters; default 16384

tools.name: logs_search
tools.description: Search the suite's log (every emulator and every function's console output) by service, level, function, call, text and time; returns the newest matching lines, oldest first.

function.description: Only this function's lines: its name or <region>-<name> id

execution.description: Only one function call's lines: the call id from functions_list_calls

text.description: Case-insensitive text the message or payload contains

q.description: Extra filter terms in the console's grammar, e.g. kind:rules.denied payload.orderId:o1 -level:debug

from.description: Lines at or after: RFC 3339, YYYY-MM-DD, today, reload (since the last Functions reload) or relative like -15m

to.description: Lines at or before, in the same forms

limit.description: At most this many lines; default 50

before.description: The older cursor of a previous search, for the lines before it

tools.name: logs_facets
tools.description: Count the log lines matching a filter by level, service, function, codebase, extension instance and kind, to see where errors and warnings come from before reading them.

function.description: Only this function's lines: its name or <region>-<name> id

execution.description: Only one function call's lines: the call id from functions_list_calls

text.description: Case-insensitive text the message or payload contains

q.description: Extra filter terms in the console's grammar, e.g. kind:rules.denied payload.orderId:o1 -level:debug

from.description: Lines at or after: RFC 3339, YYYY-MM-DD, today, reload (since the last Functions reload) or relative like -15m

to.description: Lines at or before, in the same forms

tools.name: rules_get
tools.description: The Security Rules in force: the Firestore rules of a database and the Storage rules of a bucket (source, whether they are enforced, the file and its problems).

service.description: Only firestore or storage; default both

bucket.description: Storage bucket; default the default bucket

tools.name: rules_evaluate
tools.description: Ask the rules in force (or a draft) whether a request would be allowed: get, list, create, update or delete on a Firestore path or Storage object as a given user or unauthenticated; returns the verdict, the rule line that decided it and each evaluated expression's value. Nothing is written.

path.description: Firestore document path (a collection path for list), or the Storage object name (a folder ending in / for list)

uid.description: Act as this signed-in user; omit for an unauthenticated request

claims.description: request.auth.token: custom claims and token fields (email, firebase.sign_in_provider...)

idToken.description: Act as the user of this emulator ID token (from auth_mint_token) instead of uid/claims

data.description: Firestore create/update: the written fields as plain JSON (update: the fields set over the existing document)

existing.description: Firestore: the document before the request as plain JSON, or null for none; default the stored document

collectionGroup.description: Firestore list: a collection-group query on the path's last collection id

source.description: Evaluate this draft rules source instead of the rules in force

bucket.description: Storage bucket; default the default bucket

tools.name: rules_list_denials
tools.description: Recent requests the Security Rules denied (app clients only; admin and owner requests skip the rules), newest last; with explain, the rule lines that denied each one.

service.description: Only firestore or storage; default both

from.description: Denials at or after: RFC 3339, today or relative like -15m

explain.description: Fetch the deciding rule lines of each denial (at most 20)

tools.name: pubsub_publish
tools.description: Publish a message to a Pub/Sub emulator topic: string data as given, other JSON as its text (base64-encoded on the wire), plus attributes.

tools.name: pubsub_list_topics
tools.description: The Pub/Sub emulator's topics with their published counts, subscriptions and the functions they trigger (schedule topics included).

tools.name: pubsub_list_subscriptions
tools.description: Every Pub/Sub subscription (of every topic, and detached ones) with its delivery type, filter, dead-letter topic and backlog.

topic.description: Only this topic's subscriptions (id or full name)

tools.name: pubsub_peek
tools.description: Peek at a subscription's backlog in delivery order without pulling, leasing or acking anything: each message's state, attempts, attributes and data.

state.description: Only messages in this state; default every state

full.description: Return each message's whole data instead of a 256-character preview

tools.name: tasks_stats
tools.description: Queue statistics of the Cloud Tasks emulator (queueStats).

tools.name: tasks_list
tools.description: The Cloud Tasks queues (with their pending and running counts) and the tasks waiting in them; with queue, only that queue's tasks, optionally in one state.

queue.description: Queue id, key (queue:<project>-<location>-<id>) or its function name

tools.name: tasks_run
tools.description: Dispatch one waiting Cloud Tasks task now instead of at its schedule time (it is sent on the next tick).

queue.description: Queue id, key or its function name

tools.name: schedules_list
tools.description: The scheduled functions (onSchedule, pubsub.schedule): expression, time zone, next runs, paused state and the latest runs with their delivery.

tools.name: schedules_run
tools.description: Run a scheduled function now: publish one tick to its schedule topic, as Cloud Scheduler would, and report the run.

function.description: Function name or its region-qualified id, e.g. nightlyReport or us-central1-nightlyReport

tools.name: eventarc_publish
tools.description: Publish a custom CloudEvent to an Eventarc channel (default the project's Firebase channel), as getEventarc().channel().publish() does, and report which functions received it and how each call ended.

text.description: Event data as plain text (instead of data)

channel.description: Full channel name or google; default projects/<project>/locations/us-central1/channels/firebase

tools.name: eventarc_list_events
tools.description: The Eventarc events the suite received, newest first (custom events, replays and the Firebase services' own), with how many functions matched, received or failed each.

channel.description: Full channel name or google; default every channel

tools.name: eventarc_get_event
tools.description: One Eventarc event with its attributes, data and every function delivery (outcome, duration, invocation id for functions_get_call).

id.description: The event id from eventarc_list_events (<nonce>-<seq>), not the CloudEvent id

tools.name: eventarc_replay_event
tools.description: Deliver a received Eventarc event again to the functions it matches (a new event, origin replay) and report the new deliveries.

id.description: The event id from eventarc_list_events (<nonce>-<seq>), not the CloudEvent id

keepId.description: Keep the original CloudEvent id; default a new one

tools.name: extensions_list
tools.description: The Firebase Extensions instances the suite runs: reference and version, state (running, loading, failed) with the load error, and their function count.

tools.name: extensions_reload
tools.description: Reload one Extensions instance (re-read its .env parameters and source, restart its functions) and report its state and functions afterwards.

tools.name: emulators_clear
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: delete all data of the chosen services (every Firestore document, every Auth user and tenant, every Storage object, every Pub/Sub topic, subscription, schema and message, every Cloud Tasks task and its history). Clearing more than one service needs confirmProject set to the project id.

confirmProject.description: The project id, required when clearing more than one service (the console's safeguard)

runTriggers.description: Firestore only: run the delete triggers of the cleared documents; default false
